description_en: Queries the price of the target instance type and the price of new subscription data disks when you upgrade a subscription ECS instance that has not expired
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceModificationPrice查询未到期的包年包月ECS实例升配时目标实例规格的价格信息、新增包年包月数据盘的价格信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-instance-modification-price --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1f2o4ldh8l0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceModificationPrice

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for which you want to query the upgrade price
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询升配价格的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The target instance type to which you want to upgrade. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66187.html to query the instance types to which you can upgrade in a specified zone.

When you send a request, the instance type parameter (InstanceType) and the data disk parameters (DataDisk.N.*) cannot both be empty. You must specify at least one of them
parameters.help_zh:
实例升配的目标实例规格。建议您先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66187.html查询指定可用区内可升配的实例规格信息。

查询时，实例规格参数（`InstanceType`）和数据盘参数（`DataDisk.N.*`）不得同时为空，必须至少指定一个
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The system disk type. This parameter is required only when you upgrade from a retired instance type to an available instance type and change a non-I/O optimized instance to an I/O optimized instance. For more information about instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55263.html.

Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘类型。仅当从已停售的实例规格升配至在售实例规格，并将非I/O优化实例规格升级为I/O优化实例规格时，才需要传入参数值。关于实例规格的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html以及https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55263.html。

取值范围：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。

默认值：无
parameters.name: system_disk_category

fields.help_en: The performance level of the system disk
fields.name: performance_level

fields.help_en: The size of the system disk
fields.name: size

fields.help_en:
The data disk type. Specify this parameter when you want to query the price of a new subscription data disk to attach to an ECS instance. The value of N ranges from 1 to 16. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: enterprise SSD (ESSD).
cloud: basic disk.

Default value: none.

When you send a request, the instance type parameter (InstanceType) and the data disk parameters (DataDisk.N.*) cannot both be empty. You must specify at least one of them
fields.help_zh:
数据盘类型。当您需要查询ECS实例挂载的新包年包月数据盘的价格时，可以传入该参数值。N的取值范围：1~16。取值范围：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
cloud：普通云盘。

默认值：无。

查询时，实例规格参数（`InstanceType`）和数据盘参数（`DataDisk.N.*`）不得同时为空，必须至少指定一个
fields.name: category

fields.help_en:
The data disk ID.
If DiskId is empty, a new data disk is added.
If DiskId is not empty, an existing data disk is modified
fields.help_zh:
数据盘id。
DiskId为空，表示新增数据盘；
DIskId不为空，表示修改数据盘
fields.name: disk_id

fields.help_en:
The performance level of the data disk when the disk type is enterprise SSD (ESSD). The value of N must be the same as the N in `DataDisk.N.Category=cloud_essd`. Valid values:

PL0: maximum random read/write IOPS of 10,000 per disk.
PL1: maximum random read/write IOPS of 50,000 per disk.
PL2: maximum random read/write IOPS of 100,000 per disk.
PL3: maximum random read/write IOPS of 1,000,000 per disk.

Default value: PL1.

For information about how to choose an ESSD performance level, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
fields.help_zh:
当数据盘类型为ESSD云盘时，设置云盘的性能等级。N的取值必须和`DataDisk.N.Category=cloud_essd`中的N保持一致。取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

默认值：PL1。

有关如何选择ESSD性能等级，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
fields.name: performance_level

fields.help_en:
The capacity of the data disk. The value of N ranges from 1 to 16. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: 20 to 32768.
cloud_ssd: 20 to 32768.
cloud_essd: The valid values depend on the value of `DataDisk.N.PerformanceLevel`.    
    - PL0: 1 to 32768.
    - PL1: 20 to 32768.
    - PL2: 461 to 32768.
    - PL3: 1261 to 32768.
cloud: 5 to 2000.

Default value: the minimum capacity size for the specified data disk type
fields.help_zh:
数据盘的容量大小。N的取值范围：1~16，内存单位为GiB。取值范围：

cloud_efficiency：20~32768。
cloud_ssd：20~32768。
cloud_essd：具体取值范围与`DataDisk.N.PerformanceLevel`的取值有关。    
    - PL0：1~32768。
    - PL1：20~32768。
    - PL2：461~32768。
    - PL3：1261~32768。
cloud：5~2000。

默认值：指定数据盘类型相应的容量大小的最小值
fields.name: size

parameters.help_en:
Transforms the network billing method. Valid values:
● PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
● PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic
parameters.help_zh:
转换网络计费方式。
● PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
● PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the temporary bandwidth upgrade. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. This parameter takes effect only when InternetMaxBandwidthOut is not empty
parameters.help_zh:
临时带宽变更开始时间，格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC。
仅当 InternetMaxBandwidthOut 不为空时生效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the temporary bandwidth upgrade. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. This parameter takes effect only when InternetMaxBandwidthOut is not empty
parameters.help_zh:
临时带宽变更结束时间，格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC。
仅当 InternetMaxBandwidthOut 不为空时生效
parameters.name: end_time
